# LibreOffice Impress GUI Interface Description

## System and Application Header

- **Operating System**: Linux (indicated by desktop environment icons and Activities menu)
- **Application**: LibreOffice Impress
- **Window Title**: `CPD_Background_Investigation_Process.pptx - LibreOffice Impress`
- **System Time**: `Oct 22 22:55`
- **System Tray Icons**: Present in top-right corner (including sound, network, and system status icons)
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons in top-right corner

## Menu Bar

- **Menu Items**: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Slide, Slide Show, Tools, Window, Help
- **Active Menu**: `Slide Show` menu is open, with the cursor hovering over it
- **Slide Show Dropdown Options**:
  - Start from First Slide (F5)
  - Start from Current Slide (Shift+F5)
  - Rehearse Timings
  - Custom Slide Show...
  - Slide Show Settings...

## Toolbar

- **Standard Toolbar**: Contains icons for common actions (New, Open, Save, Print, Cut, Copy, Paste, Undo, Redo, etc.)
- **Drawing Toolbar**: Includes shape tools (rectangle, oval, line, arrow, etc.)
- **Formatting Toolbar**: Contains text formatting tools (font size, bold, italic, underline, text color, alignment, etc.)
- **Slide Show Toolbar**: Includes icons for slide show controls (start, stop, next, previous, etc.)

## Sidebar (Left Panel)

- **Slides Panel**:
  - Shows thumbnails of slides 1 through 4
  - Slide 1 is currently selected (highlighted)
  - Each slide thumbnail includes a preview of its content
  - Slide 1 thumbnail shows the title slide with the Columbus Police Department logo
  - Slide 2 thumbnail shows a flowchart with yellow boxes
  - Slide 3 thumbnail shows a slide with a magnifying glass and images
  - Slide 4 thumbnail shows a slide with a gray patterned background
  - Star icons indicate favorite slides (Slide 2 and Slide 3 are marked as favorites)
- **Application Dock Icons**: Vertical dock on the left side of the screen with icons for:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress (currently active)
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Ubuntu Software
  - Help (question mark icon)
  - Trash

## Main Slide Area

- **Current Slide**: Slide 1 of 4 (as indicated in the status bar)
- **Slide Content**:
  - **Left Side**:
    - Large circular logo of the Columbus Police Department
    - The logo includes an eagle, a ship, and the text "COLUMBUS, OHIO POLICE"
    - Surrounding text: "RESPECT INTEGRITY DISCIPLINE ENTHUSIASM PROFESSIONALISM"
    - A faint reflection of the logo is visible below it
  - **Right Side**:
    - A large image of the Columbus city skyline at night
    - Overlaid on the image is a circular logo for the "HUMAN RESOURCES BUREAU" and "BACKGROUND INVESTIGATION SECTION"
    - The logo includes an eagle, a ship, and the text "COLUMBUS, OHIO POLICE"
    - Below the image, a red horizontal line
    - Text below the line: "THE CITY OF COLUMBUS" and "MICHAEL B. COLEMAN MAYOR" and "DIVISION OF POLICE"
  - **Bottom Center**:
    - Title: "The Background Investigation Process" in large blue text
    - Slide number: "1" in the bottom right corner

## Properties Panel (Right Panel)

- **Panel Title**: Properties
- **Slide Properties**:
  - Format: On-screen w (4:3)
  - Orientation: Landscape
  - Background: None
  - Master Slide: Title Slide
  - Master Background: Checked
  - Master Objects: Checked
  - Master View: Button available
- **Layouts Section**:
  - Contains a grid of layout thumbnails
  - The second layout from the top row is selected (highlighted with a red border)
  - Layouts include various arrangements of title and content areas

## Status Bar

- **Slide Information**: "Slide 1 of 4 (3)"
- **Position Information**: "-2.32 / -0.30"
- **Dimensions**: "0.00 x 0.00"
- **Language**: "English (USA)"
- **Zoom Level**: "107%"
- **Navigation Controls**: Zoom slider and +/- buttons for zooming

## Additional UI Elements

-
